summary: Iteration 3 targeted retest. Navbar centering FIX VERIFIED at all viewports (1280/1600/1920/390) - perfectly symmetric before and after scroll. Services 1-5 use the 5 new customer-assets photos and services 6-15 remain unsplash - all 15 in correct order. WhyChooseUs bento grid renders 7 cards with data-testids 1-7 including the featured '15+' card. Mobile above-the-fold (390x844) - all 6 required hero elements fit inside 844px. HOWEVER, a critical Tailwind config bug was discovered: the `vapor-*` color palette (including vapor-secondary purple) is silently overridden by a duplicate `colors:` key in tailwind.config.js. As a result, the Hero heading 'Raj Home Massage' is NOT in the intended purple accent color (computed color is navy #10202d, same as onbackground), and the Hero Book Now CTA has NO purple gradient background (computed backgroundImage: 'none'), leaving white text on a near-white surface = effectively invisible button label. This affects the user-reported issue #2 (dull hero) and directly contradicts the review requirement that the CTA background be a purple gradient with readable text. Elsewhere in the app the same bug likely affects any `text-vapor-*` / `bg-vapor-*` utility, but the app still looks OK because `glass-panel`, `mesh-bg`, `soft-3d`, `btn-3d` etc. are defined as custom CSS classes in index.css, not Tailwind utilities.

ui_bugs.issue: Duplicate `colors:` key inside theme.extend - the second one (shadcn palette starting line 50) silently overwrites the first one (vapor palette starting line 14). Consequence: all `text-vapor-*`, `bg-vapor-*`, `border-vapor-*`, `from-vapor-*`, `to-vapor-*` Tailwind utilities are NOT generated. Fix: merge both objects into a single `colors: { ...vapor palette..., ...shadcn keys... }` block.

'Raj Home Massage' span uses class `text-vapor-secondary` but computed color is rgb(16,32,45) (navy onbackground), NOT the intended purple #6f5092. Root cause = the tailwind duplicate-colors bug above.

Class `bg-gradient-to-r from-vapor-secondary to-[#8a63b8]` produces computed backgroundImage='none' -> button has no purple gradient, only glass/white ambient; white text becomes nearly invisible. Screenshot confirms button label 'Book Now' is barely readable. Root cause = same tailwind duplicate-colors bug.

rca of the issue: In /app/frontend/tailwind.config.js under theme.extend, the object literal has two `colors:` keys. In JS object literals a later duplicate key overwrites the earlier one, so the shadcn `colors` block (line 50) removes the entire `vapor` palette (line 14) from Tailwind's color theme. Consequently, class strings like `text-vapor-secondary`, `bg-vapor-secondary`, `from-vapor-secondary` never generate CSS rules, so those elements silently fall back to inherited text color and no gradient background. Reproduction: DevTools -> #hero-heading > span:nth-child(2) computed color = rgb(16,32,45) instead of purple; hero-book-now-button computed background-image = 'none'. Mitigation: merge both `colors` blocks into one, e.g. `colors: { vapor: {...}, background: 'hsl(var(--background))', ... }`.
